description: Dry-run a post before creating it: checks copy against each platform's character limit, flags profiles that are not connected or need reconnecting, warns when a platform requires media, reports each target's video limit when a video is attached, and reports the credit cost against the workspace balance. Costs nothing and publishes nothing. Run this before create_post whenever the copy is long, carries a link, or targets several platforms.

mediaUrl.description: Media that would be attached, if any. A video URL makes the check report per-platform video limits.

platforms.description: Whole platforms the post would go to, same shape as create_post.

targetAccounts.description: Profiles the post would go to, same shape as create_post.

content.description: Copy for this profile only, overriding the shared content. Use it to write natively for each platform - a 280-character post for X, a longer one for LinkedIn.

mediaUrl.description: Media for this profile only, overriding the shared mediaUrl.

workspaceId.description: Workspace (project) id to act on, from list_workspaces. Omit to use the caller's default workspace. Always pass this when the user belongs to more than one workspace.

name: preflight_post
